show.description: When a bride catches her groom cheating moments before the wedding, she shockingly marries a stranger only to discover he’s more than he seems. The Big Shot’s Wife is a gripping saga of betrayal, identity, and empowerment set against the backdrop of Mumbai’s high society. Secrets unravel, loyalties shift, and one woman finds her voice in the chaos. Watch Now !
